title: Notification delivery
subtitle: Get the items of your notifications centre by email or Telegram. Only titles and links are sent, and only items you may see.
privacy: Messages contain titles, counts and admin links only, never content bodies or secrets. Each run checks your permissions again before sending.
error.mode: Choose how email should be sent.
error.hour: Choose an hour between 00 and 23 UTC.
email.title: Email
email.mode_immediate_help: One email with what is new, checked every 5 minutes.
email.mode_digest_help: One email a day at the hour below with everything not sent yet.
email.not_configured: Configure mail first: the site has no mail provider yet.
email.ask_admin: Ask an administrator to set it up.
email.heading: %d new notifications
telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.not_configured: Telegram is not set up for this site.
telegram.not_linked: Link your Telegram account to receive notifications from the site's bot.
telegram.link_step_open: Open the bot in Telegram and press Start.
telegram.link_step_code: If Telegram does not send it for you, send this message to the bot:
telegram.link_expiry: The code works once and expires at
telegram.enabled_help: One message with what is new, checked every 5 minutes.
telegram.blocked: Telegram delivery was turned off because the bot was blocked. Unblock the bot, then turn delivery on again.
telegram.unlink_confirm: Unlink Telegram? You will stop receiving messages there.
telegram.reply_linked: Linked. You will receive your admin notifications here.
telegram.reply_invalid: This code is not valid or has expired. Create a new one under My account → Notifications.
categories.title: What to send
categories.help: Muted items still appear in the notifications centre.
test.title: Send a test
test.help: Sends a sample message to you. At most 3 per channel every 10 minutes.
test.failed: The test message could not be sent. Check the channel settings and the logs.
test.rate_limited: Too many test messages. Try again in a few minutes.
settings.title: Notification delivery
settings.subtitle: Site-wide channels for notification delivery. Each user chooses their own channels under My account.
settings.bot_help: Create a bot with @BotFather, paste its token and username, save, then register the webhook. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings.token_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored token. A new token replaces it and requires registering the webhook again.
settings.token_invalid: This does not look like a bot token.
settings.username_invalid: Enter the bot's username, ending in “bot”.
settings.webhook_https: Telegram needs the site's base URL (GORUN_BASE_URL) on https.
settings.webhook_failed: Telegram did not accept the webhook. Check the token and that the site is reachable on https.
settings.remove_help: Deletes the stored token and webhook secret. Linked users keep their link but receive nothing until a bot is set up again.
unsubscribe.title: Stop notification emails
